blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Lower Landing

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Lower Landing are served by Bernard Elementary, Central Elementary, A.D. Rundle Middle School, Chilliwack Middle, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33 (confirm exact street catchment via SD33 School Locator). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Island 22 Regional Park (Fraser River boat launch, off-leash dog area, mountain bike skills park, and dike trails), Townsend Park, and Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre nearby. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by nearby BC Transit routes along Ashwell Road, Hodgins Avenue, and Downtown Chilliwack, plus fast access to Highway 1 Exit 116 and Exit 119.

In SD33, Lower Landing is served by or near Chilliwack Secondary School, Chilliwack Middle, A.D. What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Lower Landing?

Residents of Lower Landing have access to Island 22 Regional Park (Fraser River boat launch, off-leash dog area, mountain bike skills park, and dike trails), Townsend Park, and Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre nearby. See our

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Lower Landing?

Key road corridors serving Lower Landing include Schweyey Road, Ashwell Road, Wolfe Road, Cartmell Road, and Young Road North toward Island 22 and Chilliwack Mountain. Public transit connections include nearby BC Transit routes along Ashwell Road, Hodgins Avenue, and Downtown Chilliwack, plus fast access to Highway 1 Exit 116 and Exit 119.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Lower Landing?

Properties in Lower Landing are governed by registered First Nations leasehold disclosure terms for Cedarbrook homes on Shxwhá:y Village lands (versus fee-simple freehold parcels nearby), Chilliwack 2050 OCP policies, and Fraser River floodplain levels. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Lower Landing freehold or leasehold?

Lower Landing homes are mostly freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata. A few select developments in the larger Chilliwack and Cultus Lake area, however, are on prepaid leasehold land. Look at the Title Type field in every MLS® listing, and ask your Realtor and lawyer to review the title search.
